description: Search US bridges in the FHWA National Bridge Inventory. Scope with state, county (3-digit FIPS code), and/or condition (Good/Fair/Poor); optional filters: posting_status (open/posted/closed/not_yet_open), owner_code, scour_critical, year_min/year_max, min_adt, route, and q (text match on facility carried, feature crossed, location). Returns decoded records with condition rollup, posting status, clearances, and labels. Read-only lookup of the FHWA NBI 2025 annual snapshot; no API key. limit defaults to 100 (max 1000); offset defaults to 0, pass offset in multiples of limit to page. Use find_bridges_nearby instead for radius queries around a point, get_worst_bridges instead for Poor-condition lists, and list_bridges_in_county instead for all bridges in one county.

condition.description: Condition rating: Good, Fair, or Poor

county.description: 3-digit FIPS county code within the state

offset.description: Results to skip for paging, default 0

owner_code.description: Agency code of the bridge owner

posting_status.description: Posting status: open, posted, closed, or not_yet_open

q.description: Text match: facility carried / feature crossed / location

name: search_bridges
